name: Route
description: Build a road to connect your capital to our city, so that caravans may travel safely between us.

name: Clear Barbarian Camp
description: Raiders have made camp near our city: Defias, gnolls or worse. Please drive them out.

name: Connect Resource
description: To make our peoples stronger, connect [tileResource] to your trade network.

name: Construct Wonder
description: Build [wonder], and let all of Azeroth see the strength of your people.

name: Acquire Great Person
description: Heroes change the course of history! You will be rewarded for gaining a new [greatPerson].

name: Conquer City State
description: The city of [cityState] has wronged us for the last time. Wipe them from the map and you will be well rewarded.

name: Find Player
description: We have not yet found where [civName] built their cities. You will be rewarded for finding their lands.

name: Find Natural Wonder
description: Send your best explorers into the wilds. Nobody has yet found [naturalWonder].

name: Give Gold
description: Raiders sent by [civName] have plundered our coffers. Unless we receive some Gold, our city will not survive.

name: Pledge to Protect
description: We need your protection against the aggression of [civName]. Pledge to protect us and seal the bond between our peoples.

name: Contest Culture
description: The people whose culture grows the most will receive a reward.

name: Contest Faith
description: The people whose faith grows the most will receive a reward.

name: Contest Technologies
description: The people who make the most new discoveries will receive a reward.

name: Invest
description: The Darkmoon Faire has come to our city, and coin is flowing! For a while, any Gold donation will yield [50]% extra Influence.

name: Bully City State
description: We are tired of the airs of [cityState]. Whoever puts them in their place by demanding tribute will be rewarded.

name: Denounce Civilization
description: We have been forced to pay tribute to [civName]! Tell all of Azeroth of their misdeeds.

name: Spread Religion
description: We have heard the teachings of [religionName] and are curious. Will you send missionaries to teach us?
